concepts.name: Charcoal — transparent hero portrait
concepts.details: Wardrobe: immaculate deep charcoal three-piece suit with elegant notch lapels, matching charcoal buttoned waistcoat and trousers, clean ivory dress shirt, dark graphite textured tie, restrained ivory pocket square. Pose: relaxed square shoulders with torso turned just 10 degrees, face toward camera, one hand resting naturally in trouser pocket, other arm at his side. Mood: credible, modern engineering professional. Soft neutral studio key and subtle warm edge light. Scene/backdrop: actual fully TRANSPARENT alpha background with no backdrop, ground, cast shadow or fake checkerboard pattern; keep hair edge detail and suit silhouette crisp. This is a reusable person cutout for layering over large website typography. No background props.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: premium photographic portrait asset for Zohaib Haider's full-stack AI engineer portfolio hero, NOT a website screenshot.
Input images: Image 1 (blue-suit formal photograph) is the PRIMARY identity reference for his exact recognizable face, natural age, facial geometry and proportions. Images 2 and 3 are supplementary facial identity references only; do not copy their selfie perspective, filters, background or text.
Primary request: create a polished professional fashion-editorial portrait of this SAME man wearing a beautifully tailored THREE-PIECE SUIT: jacket plus visibly buttoned matching waistcoat plus matching trousers. Preserve his identity, brown eyes, thick eyebrows, distinctive swept black hair, moustache, light short beard, natural warm skin tone and facial marks. Do not replace him with a generic model or change his ethnicity, age or facial structure. Grooming should be neat but natural. His entire face and both eyes must be unobstructed, crisply detailed and gently illuminated. Confident approachable expression, calm direct eye contact, subtle natural smile.
Style: exceptionally realistic premium studio photography, 85mm lens at eye level, realistic pores and skin detail, exquisite fine wool fabric and seams, accurate human anatomy, flattering tailored fit, no plastic skin. Three-quarter-length portrait from full head and hair to mid-thigh. Leave a little air around head and both elbows; do not crop hair or shoulders. The open jacket must clearly reveal the matching waistcoat, not just a two-piece suit.
Constraints: ONE portrait of ONE man only, vertical 2:3 composition, high detail. No words, UI, graphic text, logos, watermark, frames, collage, medals, crowns, sunglasses, holograms, laptops or code. No dramatic shadow hiding facial features.

concepts.name: Forest — warm editorial studio
concepts.details: Wardrobe: sophisticated very dark forest-green wool three-piece suit, matching buttoned waistcoat and trousers, soft ivory dress shirt, deep green silk-knit tie, small ivory pocket square, restrained unbranded wristwatch. Pose: standing with one hand gently adjusting the opposite cuff at waist height, fingers anatomically natural, waistcoat visible above hands. Scene: warm sand/cream studio cyclorama with one large sculptural curved architectural plane behind him and gentle directional shadows; spacious and restrained. Lighting: beautiful warm daylight key with subtle deep-green edge separation, face bright and clear, not green tinted. Palette: forest green, warm ivory, sand. Premium contemporary editorial photographed on a real set; the man is the clear focus.

concepts.name: Ember — copper cinematic studio
concepts.details: Wardrobe: elegant black fine-wool three-piece suit with matching black buttoned waistcoat and trousers, ivory dress shirt, black silk tie and modest ivory pocket square. Pose: standing naturally, one hand lightly touching the jacket opening below the waistcoat, other arm relaxed; slight body turn, friendly composed direct gaze. Scene: sophisticated charcoal-black studio with a broad soft copper-orange elliptical light gradient BEHIND him, subtle bronze architectural curved surface out of focus at edge. Moody dimensional premium editorial lighting, but a large neutral softbox illuminates the entire face so both eyes and identity remain completely clear. Fine amber rim separation on the suit. Restrained warmth, not neon or sci-fi. Hero-quality photography, not poster graphics.

concepts.name: Platinum — monochrome editorial
concepts.details: Wardrobe: refined medium-gray subtle pinstripe three-piece suit with matching buttoned waistcoat and trousers, pristine white shirt, charcoal tie, crisp white pocket square. Pose: leaning very slightly on the edge of a low simple stone plinth with one hand resting on it and other hand casually in trouser pocket; upright professional posture; full face direct to camera with a tiny approachable smile. Scene: minimal light-gray seamless architectural studio with one oversized soft oval shadow and clean pale geometric plinth; airy, quietly bold and magazine-editorial. BLACK AND WHITE photography with nuanced silver, black and ivory tonality; bright natural skin luminance, accurate facial likeness, expressive eyes. Sculpted soft daylight, smooth background falloff, fine restrained photographic grain. Modern, human, distinctive.
